display.name: Figma
display.blurb: Read Figma files, render image exports, browse projects/components/styles, and post comments — authenticated with a brokered personal access token in the X-Figma-Token header.

cli.doc:
Use `figma` to read from Figma during a run — files, image exports, comments, projects, components, and styles. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects a brokered personal access token in the `X-Figma-Token` header on every request to api.figma.com; `FIGMA_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT set a real token or run any login.

Most commands take a <file-key> — the id from a Figma file URL (figma.com/file/<KEY>/... or figma.com/design/<KEY>/...).

Identity check: `figma whoami` (GET /v1/me, requires `me:read`).
Get a file's document JSON: `figma file <file-key> [field=value …]` (e.g. `depth=2`) — requires `files:read`. File metadata: `figma meta <file-key>`. Specific nodes: `figma nodes <file-key> ids=1:2,1:3`. Version history: `figma versions <file-key>`.
Render image exports of nodes: `figma images <file-key> ids=1:2 format=png scale=2` (GET /v1/images, requires `images:read`) — returns a JSON map of node-id → temporary S3 URL.
Comments: list with `figma comments <file-key>` (requires `comments:read`); add with `figma comment <file-key> "text…"` (POST, requires `comments:write`).
Projects: `figma projects <team-id>` lists a team's projects; `figma project-files <project-id>` lists files in a project (requires `projects:read`).
Library: `figma components <team-id>`, `figma styles <team-id>`, `figma component <key>`, `figma style <key>` (requires `components:read`).
Generic GET: `figma get <path> [field=value …]` — e.g. `figma get /v1/files/<file-key>/dev_resources`. Whether a path is reachable depends on the powers your profile granted; ungranted paths are denied at the network boundary, not authenticated.
